answer:
You should use **`VectorStoreIndex`**. The docs show it being imported and built from your documents with `from_documents`:

"The simplest way to use a Vector Store is to load a set of documents and build an index from them using `from_documents`:" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/indexing/vector_store_index.md]

"from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex, SimpleDirectoryReader" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/indexing/vector_store_index.md]

A shorter example from the indexing guide uses the same class: "index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(documents)" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/rag/indexing/index.md]
